description: The signed passport of a product (a Global Trade Item Number, GTIN) or a retail banner (market/banner, e.g. FR/Carrefour): which hub holds its record, where it is cleared, its compliance records, who lists it, where the payment door is. Read live from the GSC hubs on every call; the first call issues version 1. subject = a GTIN (8 to 14 digits) or market/banner; kind = gtin or banner (optional).
name: get_passport
title: Get Passport
